title: Las Vegas Death Valley Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the stunning landscapes of Death Valley on a full-day tour from Las Vegas. Visit the quirky Area 51 Alien Center, explore Rhyolite Ghost Town, walk the famed Mesquite Flat Sand Dunes, and discover Badwater Basin, the lowest point in North America. Enjoy stops at Furnace Creek, Harmony Borax Works, and the breathtaking Zabriskie Point on this unforgettable desert adventure.
